title: What an Operating System Does
subtitle: From firmware that runs alone to a kernel that hides the hardware, keeps programs apart and shares the processor, watched step by step on a real Linux system.
prerequisite_note: Chapter 0's lab, and C up to functions and pointers.
objectives: Describe superloop firmware and where it breaks down.
Name and demonstrate abstraction, isolation and sharing.
Show separate address spaces with fork and a contained crash.
Measure time sharing on one core.
Explain user mode, kernel mode, system calls and ARM64 exception levels.
